title: getPublishProgress request
description: GET /v1/publishes/{publishId}/progress - request. Projection progress of a publish in this cell (completeness per unit).
$comment: Source: DISENO S3 (e), AP-I7, publish_progress; EV-23 PublishProjectionCompleted.v1; PRD RF-022, RF-084. Audience: OPERATOR (projection part of RF-022; the fan-out part is ms-publish-fanout GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}, DEC-33). Residency: REGIONAL (cell); OPERATIONAL data, no engagement ids. Idempotency: safe read (GET). Pagination: none (bounded by source versions x N_shards).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).
